mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market stress that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 in regression analysis.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 2000 thousand units signals weakening residential demand that precedes economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 2000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO < 100), a further decline in industrial production signals deepening supply constraints that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP and retail sales indicate a synchronized economic contraction that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05 in regression analysis.
